title: Auto start-stop and remote start
summary: Feedback on this topic centers on dissatisfaction with auto start-stop behavior and controls, while a smaller set of comments mentions remote start favorably or descriptively.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise using remote start and mention auto start-stop working well, though the positive sample is limited.

negative.summary: Negative reviews focus on wanting auto start-stop to stay off permanently, disliking the feature, and finding restart behavior harsh or jolting.

mixed.summary: The mixed review expresses only mild dissatisfaction with auto start-stop and a desire to disable it permanently.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews describe requests for remote start, use of remote start, references to the lack of an auto start-stop off option, and one note that the feature works well without clear evaluative context.

signal_notes.interpretation: The exploratory signal indicates that negative or mixed feedback in this topic is associated with ICE examples, while the non-ICE comparison examples shown here do not include negative or mixed sentiment.

limitations: Most sampled examples are undetermined, so the evaluative picture is limited.
This topic mixes two related but distinct subjects, auto start-stop and remote engine start, which reduces thematic coherence.
Sampled fragments are stratified examples and should not be treated as representative of all reviews on this topic.
